segments.text: The protagonist of the "Otaku Detective Runs!" scenario. A detective in the Shibuya Central Police Station's Public Safety Division, Juvenile Section. 25 years old. He loves games and calls himself a "gamer," but is indignant when people around him call him an "otaku." He has a strong sense of justice, but is also very opinionated, and often rushes ahead without listening to the advice of those around him. He also has a habit of using old expressions in conversation.
He is treated as a problem child at the station, as he frequently hangs out at game centers while on duty, and as such few people at the station tolerate him.
His favorite food is Snow Brand Coffee Milk. His hobbies include digital-related hardware such as computers and games. His special skill is the yo-yo.
From Wikipedia

The protagonist of the "The Wrong Man - Bull" scenario. Former yakuza. 36 years old. After quitting the yakuza business six months ago, he fell in love with Takamine Aya, who works at a jewelry store, and decided to propose to her. He has a strong physique and a tough face, and is a fighter who rose to the position of daikashi (the second highest rank in the gang). He is feared by the yakuza and called "Raging Bull".

He is not good at talking with people, and his unique way of speaking often makes others feel as if he doesn't understand them. He has a large vertical scar on his right cheek and a tattoo of a Gozu Tennō on his back.

By happenstance, he is replaced by an actor who looks exactly like him, Umabe Jintaro, and ends up playing the role of a yakuza boss. He is not familiar with the entertainment industry, does not understand any industry terminology, and is not good at remembering lines, but as a former yakuza, director Kabazawa praised him for his acting, saying that he gives off "has the right presence".
His hobbies are drinking, and his special skill is fighting. He is a Taurus.
Ushio's mother and Umabe's mother are identical twins.
From Wikipedia

The protagonist of the "The Wrong Man - Horse" scenario. An actor. 36 years old. He's had a long career, but has yet to become famous. Until now, he had only played minor roles where he would be killed as soon as he appeared on screen, but this time he was given a major role for the first time. However, he was nervous and he had not been acting well, and he felt even worse due to the crew treated him coldly whenever he made a mistake. Since he had played many roles as characters who die, he's good at acting out falls, and could do some stunts himself. However, he is an extremely bad swimmer who hates even small pools, and has refused any jobs that require him to go into water, which has in turn affected his career's downward slope.

His face and physique are similar to Ushio Masami, but his personality is the complete opposite, as he is kind-hearted and timid. The scar on his right cheek, which looks the same as Ushio's scar, is simply makeup for the role. By happenstance, he is mistaken for Ushio Masami, a former yakuza who looks just like him, and he ends up getting caught up in a commotion involving the yakuza.
He has a sweet tooth and cannot tolerate alcohol or tobacco. His hobby is eating sweets. His special skill is impersonating movie stars. He's a Sagittarius.
From Wikipedia

The protagonist of the "Shichiyokai" scenario. A fourth-year student at Midoriyama Academy. 21 years old. The only son of a middle-class family whose father works for the major home appliance manufacturer "Yotsubishi". He has a few friends and has never been in a deep relationship with a woman. He sometimes finds himself at the mercy of those around him, but he is straightforward and does not get depressed.

He had a very ordinary college life and was offered a job at his father's company through his connections, but he was blackmailed using his past participation in student movements, and was recruited as "Friday", a member of the blackmail organization "Shichiyokai".
His hobbies are pachinko and walking. He is a Scorpio.
From Wikipedia

The protagonist of the "Schrödinger's Hand" scenario. A TV scriptwriter. 38 years old. As a writer, he works under the pen name "Tetsuo Nakashima" and does not use his real name unless he feels very confident in his work. At the age of 28, he won a literary newcomer's award and started making a living as a writer. A few years ago, he worked on a TV drama that became a huge hit, which made him famous in the industry, and he has been writing plots for various TV dramas ever since.

Although he wants to write high-quality stories, he is disgusted by the reality that there is a demand for low-quality dramas and that he is involved in most of them. He also feels uneasy when strangers submit their own works pretending to be him.

He suffers from neurosis caused by stress, and frequently takes sleeping pills to escape reality, and has such a stoic way of thinking that he finds value in them. He also uses alcohol (he prefers straight bourbon) and caffeine pills.
Although he has his own home, he lives at the Nanbu Hotel in Shibuya. As the hotel does all the house cleaning, he rarely goes home.
His hobby is watching movies (recently he mostly watches them for work reference). His special skill is drawing. He is a Capricorn.
From Wikipedia

The protagonist of the "De-ki-cha-ta" scenario. A third-year student at Midoriyama Academy High School. 18 years old. A good-looking athlete who played in the basketball club and was a former student council president with excellent grades. A popular guy who is trusted by boys, girls, and teachers, he is always hanging out with multiple girls. He is affable and eloquent, so he is good at telling lies to make people trust him.

While dating Akiba Minako, the only daughter of the president of a major mail-order company, he gets Kurashina Ami pregnant in a one-night stand, and then discovers that he already has a son with his ex-girlfriend Katase Yuki, and is troubled by a strange love square.
His hobby is talking to girls. His special skill is getting along with girls. He is a Gemini.
From Wikipedia

The protagonist of the "Lost Foreign Legion" scenario. A member of the French Foreign Legion. 25 years old. After being bullied as a child, he learned various martial arts. As he grew up, he began to question his life, and left Japan three years ago to join the French Foreign Legion. However, after spending all his time in rigorous training and fighting, he realized that he had a sadistic side that loved violence, such as killing babies and prostitutes, and effectively deserted the Legion and returned to Japan.

In combat, he is good at fighting opponents that wield knives, and is proud of his special technique where he holds down the enemy's dominant wrist and slices the opponent's throat with the tip of their blade.
His hobbies are reading. His special skill is playing the tenor saxophone. He is a Libra.
From Wikipedia

The protagonist of the "Desire to Lose Weight" scenario. 20 years old. Part-time worker. She has a strong appetite and is overweight, which her boyfriend Yoichi has pointed out to her. She starts an insane diet to lose 17 kg in 5 days, hoping that he won't dump her. She has an optimistic and cheerful personality, but once she feels down, she can become extremely depressed or become so ecstatic that she can't see anything else around her. When she eats something delicious, she has a habit of looking pleased and her eyes focus on her brow.
Her hobbies and special skills are eating. She is a Leo.
From Wikipedia

segments.text: The titular protagonist of the hidden PSP-exclusive "Patrick Dandy" scenario. He is a US Army colonel who calls himself an astronaut, but his appearance, words, and actions makes him appear suspicious. He claims to be 48 years old, an aristrocrat connected to the British royal family and Russian Romanov dynasty, and also that he's being pursued by the CIA.

The titular protagonist of the hidden PSP-exclusive "Sagiyama" scenario. An aspiring screenwriter. After graduating from university, he becomes an assistant director to get to know the industry, but the stress of the job makes him want to quit on the first day. He's recently been interested in a high school girl named Fukamachi Yui.
A student at Midoriyama Academy High School. He is a rival erotic manga artist to Aoi Norio.
